raw_text: Cotopaxi Allpa 35L Travel Pack. Gear for good. The Allpa is the adventure travel pack that opens like a suitcase and carries like a dream of organization. Price: $200.00. Weight: 1.6 kg. Capacity: 35 liters. Dimensions: 51 x 33 x 25 cm — carry-on compatible on most airlines. Full-wrap zipper with a clamshell opening: the entire bag opens flat, revealing a large mesh-covered right-side compartment and a subdivided left side with zippered mesh pockets — organization built in, no packing cubes needed. Padded laptop sleeve (fits 15") plus a tablet sleeve with soft lining, accessible from the top. Low-profile harness with padded shoulder straps and a removable padded hip belt. Theft-proof: security YKK zippers throughout and reinforced anti-slash TPU-coated 1000D polyester shell with 840D ballistic nylon paneling. Each Del Día colorway is one of a kind, made with repurposed fabric decided by workers in the factory — llama approved. Covered by our Guaranteed for Good lifetime warranty. B Corp certified company.
